note: Close-up flood photos from Unsplash, the use case of a resident photographing a vehicle a few metres away. Unsplash License: free to use, no permission needed, attribution appreciated (https://unsplash.com/license). The photos are not stored in git: eval/real_photos.py copies them from $NEERMATTAM_CLOSE_DIR (default ~/neermattam-data/probe/close, files u_<id>.jpg) into eval/photos/, or downloads them from the 'download' URL. Photographer names were read from each photo page on 2026-10-29. None of the photos has a measured water depth, so there is no ground truth.
